name: Warden
text:
Decision: We should run a full asset inventory scan of all public-facing systems and endpoints—no exceptions—using an automated tool that checks for hidden or misconfigured services, open ports, and unexpected data flows.

Why: This is the fastest way to find real leaks or injection points before attackers do. Manual checks can miss things, and partial scans leave blind spots. The trade-off is time and noise—some alerts will be false positives—but catching one real issue outweighs the cost of sorting through a few duds.
